utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Before we get too far, Hana, can we confirm the storage spot and who’s putting out the drop-off signs? I’d feel better knowing parking and unloading won’t turn into a mess.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes—before we lock that in, can we double-check whether we’ve confirmed the storage spot and sign setup yet, or if we still just have the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps firmly set?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: As far as I know, we only have the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps firmly set, so I’d really like to pin down the storage spot and who’s handling the signs before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, still on my end—I’ll bring the drill and ladder over, and I can chip in a little too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—thanks, Gus. Bring them Saturday morning and I’ll help sort the tools when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo—I’ll bring the drill and ladder Saturday morning and be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’m hearing, it’s still sounding like Saturday morning at the community center, with folks mostly just spreading the word and pooling tools and parts.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Close—it’s Saturday morning at the community lot, and I’m telling everyone to bring any useful tools or spare parts while we keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, good catch—community lot, not the center; I’ll pass that along and keep telling folks to bring tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Uli, I’ve got my supply notes handy—tell me what the repair drive is still missing, and I’ll check what I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I only heard they’re gathering by the community hall, near the side entrance, and folks were asking around for tools and spare parts. I’m keeping to myself a bit, but that’s what I know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli—that helps; I’ll note the community hall side entrance and check my list for tools and spare parts we can bring.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still pulling people together, but we really need the date locked in first so I can give everyone something solid to plan around.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Works for me—once the date’s locked, just tell me what needs hauling and where, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Bo—once we pin the date down, I’ll loop you in with the hauling list and where we’re staging everything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still only getting this second-hand, but is Mara the one keeping the repair drive list now, or are folks still just bringing tools and a little money?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think Rosa’s pulling the list together right now, but it still sounds pretty loose—folks are mostly just bringing tools and a little money.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, thanks—I’d heard Mara’s name, but if Rosa’s pulling the list together, I’ll wait and check with her before I bring anything by.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Eli—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam—we’re still working from the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps for sure, and I need to sort the remaining houses once everyone checks in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it—I can take point on the fence fix and help you sort the remaining houses once folks check in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m coming in a little late, but last I heard the confirmed repairs were the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps, and we still need tools, cash, and a box of mixed screws.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane—that helps; Saturday around 9:30 still works best for me as long as I’m free by school pickup, and I can plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That lines up with what I’ve heard, Faye—Saturday around 9:30 sounds like the best lead so far, and I’ll keep passing it along once someone locks it in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Opal—that signup sheet will help a ton, and if you spot those Maple Court volunteers, send them my way so we can get them folded in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do—I’ll keep an eye out around Maple Court and point any volunteers over to the community center this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Opal—thanks for helping keep everyone connected; I’ll be by the community center this afternoon if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, but if you’ve got an update from Noah, send it my way—I’m still telling folks we need duct tape, mixed screws, and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, I think it’s Saturday at 9 by the shed, and Gus said he’s bringing the drill and ladder. I’m still trying to find my gloves, so duct tape and mixed screws still sound worth telling folks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That helps—thanks; I’m still out running errands, but I’ll keep telling people Saturday at 9 by the shed and that we still need duct tape, mixed screws, and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mina, Saturday morning at the community center still works for me, and I can get there early to help set up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—can you handle early setup at the community lot, and do you already have the tables and sign-in stuff covered?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can handle the early setup, but I was planning on the community center—if we’ve moved it to the lot, I’ll adjust, and I can bring the sign-in stuff if someone can confirm the tables.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oren, before I commit, can you confirm the time, the exact place, and what supplies are already covered so far?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m pretty sure it’s this Saturday morning at the community lot, but I’m fuzzy on supplies—I only know the fence and Mrs. Alvarez’s steps are the confirmed fixes so far.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you double-check the exact start time and whether it’s the community center or the lot, and confirm the full supplies list before I commit?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’ve heard, it’s still set for Saturday morning at the community center, and Mara’s even planning to get there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — one correction: we moved it to Sunday at the community center. If you can, please let Mara know so she doesn’t show up a day early.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh goodness, thanks for catching that—I’ll pass word to Mara that it’s Sunday at the community center so she doesn’t head over on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, what still needs fixing for the repair drive, and what can I take off your list today?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit fuzzy, Mina, but I know the bench by the garden and that squeaky gate still need checking, and the fence fix plus Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps are the only confirmed jobs so far.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—who’s taking the bench and gate, and do you want me to lock down the fence or Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps today?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Gus, before we get too far, can you double-check the drop-off spot and side-street parking plan with me? I just don’t want Saturday to get clogged up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia—I’ll go over the drop-off spot and parking with you, and I’m still bringing the drill and ladder Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus—that helps, but can we also make sure the drill and ladder can be set aside near the shed without blocking the drop-off flow?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Ira, I’ve got the supply notes ready—tell me what the repair drive is still short on, and I’ll see what I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Cleo—I’m still out on errands, but we’re still short on a box of mixed screws; Mina’s already got the duct tape and gloves covered.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good to know—I've got mixed screws in my stock, so set that box aside for the repair drive and we’ll mark tape and gloves as covered.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m connecting a few neighbors for the repair drive—can you send me the current drop-off list so I can point people to what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, Jules—I’ll send over the current drop-off list, and I’m still set for Saturday morning at the community center if we need to sort anything in person.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks—once you send it over, I’ll start matching people to what’s still needed and let folks know Saturday morning is an option.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Noah—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think we’re set on the drill and ladder—could you just meet us Saturday at 9 by the shed, and maybe I’ll see if I can find my gloves before then?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll be there Saturday at 9 by the shed, and if you can’t find the gloves, I’ll bring an extra pair.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but last I heard the confirmed repairs were the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps, and tools plus cash were still being tracked as supply needs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That matches what I have—fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps are confirmed, and I’m still tracking tools and cash support for the community center drive this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good, then I’m caught up—unless someone’s added another repair since I came in late, I’d keep it to those two and the tool-and-cash support.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Rey, before we move forward, can you confirm we’ve still only firmly added the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think so, yes—those are the only ones that sound firmly added, and the bench by the garden and squeaky gate still seem more like pending fixes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey—that matches what I had, so I’ll keep us focused on just the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps until anything else is confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep—still good for Saturday around 9:30; I’ll bring the drill and gloves, and you can point me at the bikes and scrap wood.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—Saturday at 9:30 at the repair drive site still works, and with your drill and gloves covered we should be in good shape as long as I can head out by school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’ll be there around 9:30 with the drill and gloves, and I’ll haul the busted bikes and scrap wood over before noon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Quinn, can you confirm the exact start time now, or should I wait before I count myself in or spread it around?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’d wait just a bit—I’m still locking down the exact start time at the community center, and I’ll send you the details as soon as they’re firm.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, I’ll hold off until you confirm the exact start time—just send it over once it’s firm.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Uli, I’m still only getting this second-hand, but is Mara the one keeping the repair drive list, or are folks still just collecting tools, supplies, and a little money?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I only heard they’re setting up by the community hall near the side entrance, and it still sounds pretty informal. Folks are collecting what they can, far as I know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Okay, that helps some—I’m still hearing it all second-hand, but it sounds like I should bring tools or supplies to the hall and maybe check if Mara’s there keeping track.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Leo, the repair drive’s this Saturday morning at the community lot, and I’m telling everyone to bring useful tools or spare parts so we get a solid turnout.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good plan — I’ll bring a basic tool kit and help sort things when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Leo — this Saturday morning at the community lot, and any useful tools or spare parts will help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—last I heard, the confirmed repairs are the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps, and tools and cash are still being collected as supply needs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane—that matches my notes, and I’m still tracking tool and supply gaps, so let me know if you hear what we’re specifically short on.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do—so far the only specific gap I’ve heard is a box of mixed screws, since Mina’s already got the duct tape and gloves covered.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Uli, the repair drive is set for Saturday morning at the community center, and I’ve already got Mara coming early to set up while Jules pulls in a few handy neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright... I can bring a few basic tools and keep to the side, if that’s still alright.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’s perfect, Uli—bring the basic tools to the community center Saturday morning, and I’ll place you where they’re easy to reach without crowding the setup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, still collecting—cash helps, but before you chip in, can you cover one concrete thing if I text you the current top need?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, please text me the top need—I’m still mostly hearing this second-hand, but I can cover one concrete thing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—I'll text you the top need as soon as Cleo confirms inventory; if it’s a parts run instead of cash, can you handle that today?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep—Saturday at 9 by the shed. Bring those gloves if you find them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, thanks—I'll keep an eye out for them, and Gus is still bringing the drill and ladder, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, that’s still the plan—drill and ladder are covered, so just bring your gloves if you find them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, but I still need duct tape, a box of mixed screws, and a couple of work gloves if anyone can grab them for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve been hearing Saturday morning at the community center, and Uli said folks may be setting up by the side entrance near the hall—if I spot anyone headed that way, I’ll pass along that you still need duct tape, mixed screws, and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess—that helps a lot; if you hear whether the side entrance setup’s confirmed, let me know while I’m still out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep—repair drive’s still on; have Mara text me what needs hauling and where, and I’ll swing by around 9:30 with the drill and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll still bring my ladder and drill by the shed, and I can chip in a little for the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—leave me the hauling list, and I’ll grab the busted bikes and scrap wood once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thank you—if I’m remembering straight, you’ve got the gate, and I still need to find who can check the bench by the garden.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can ask around about the bench if you want; the gate’s still on my list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be a big help, Rey—thank you; I keep muddling the bench, but I know the gate’s in good hands with you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Late morning still seems best to me—would something like 11 work for you so it stays clear of school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 11 works for me better than 9:30, as long as we keep it to the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps so I can head out for school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, 11 it is—we’ll keep it focused on the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps so you can get out in time for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, before we get too far, can we pin down the drop-off spot and who’s handling parking signs? I’d feel better if that’s settled before the weekend rush.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now, and I’m lining up the parking signs today so that piece is covered.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s a relief—can we also confirm exactly where donations will be stored at the community center so people know where to bring things?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still pulling people in from a few different blocks, but we really need the date locked down before I can give folks a clear ask for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—let’s lock it in now. What date works best with the community center schedule and the volunteers you’ve lined up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d help a ton—if the community center has an opening next Saturday, I can start confirming the handy folks I’ve been talking with and give everyone something concrete.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Kira, right now we’ve only firmly got the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps, plus duct tape, mixed screws, and work gloves on the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the time and exact place too, and whether that supply list is fully confirmed with Cleo before we call anything else missing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re meeting at nine, and Gus is bringing the ladder and drill over then; as for the supplies, the duct tape, mixed screws, and work gloves are what I’ve got confirmed on the list so far, and I’d rather wait on Cleo before adding anything else missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Hana, we’re pulling folks together for the repair drive by the community center this afternoon—if you can make it, I’d love to count you in, and feel free to spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn—I can help, but before I spread the word, can you confirm whether we’re still only set on the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, that’s what we’ve got lined up for this afternoon so far—the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps, and I’d love your help spreading the word.
